note: The overnight charging decision of docs/use-cases.md section 4.2 (U4c). Every value is a stylised choice of the example, not read from a depot.
need: the predicted energy of the route plus the safety, in kWh, by the departure hour (07:00 the next day = hour 31 from the start of the day); a truck can draw from the hour after its last arrival
grid: the depot file's cap_kw is what the warehouse leaves for charging; the tariff is the depot file's, in thousandths of a currency unit per kWh
